content: That is it. I know that it is smaller than you wanted, but it is one of the nicest apartments in the building.
No. There are two. The master bedroom is quite spacious, though. Maybe you could let the children share the larger room, and you and your husband could use the smaller one.
I suppose that I could do that.
A three-bedroom apartment will be difficult to find.
Yes I know. Believe me, I have been looking for over a week. The few three-bedroom apartments that I have found are either extremely expensive or the owner won't allow children.
Well, the owner allows two children in this apartment complex.
No. I am the manager. I live here, too, on the first floor of this building.
Oh. That's nice. Then if anything gets broken ...
Just leave a note on my door,
You said that the rent would be $ 350 a month. Does that include any of the utilities?
Yes. It includes gas. Your furnace and stove are gas, so, as you can imagine, your other utilities, electric and water, are quite inexpensive.
This sounds better and better. But before I sign a lease, I would like my husband to see it.
Why not stop by with him this evening?
How late are you open? My husband doesn't get off work until five.
Come by at six. I will still be in the office. I am sure that you are eager to move from the hotel, and if we get the paperwork out of the way tonight, you can move in tomorrow.
